scripts.setup: npm install && node scripts/init-env.mjs && npm --workspace stack/backend run prisma:generate && npm --workspace stack/backend run prisma:deploy && npm --workspace stack/backend run seed
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c yellow,green "npm --workspace stack/backend run start:dev" "npm --workspace stack/frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm --workspace stack/backend run build && npm --workspace stack/frontend run build
scripts.test: npm --workspace stack/backend test && npm --workspace stack/frontend test
scripts.lint: npm --workspace stack/backend run lint && npm --workspace stack/frontend run lint
